Third-party code bundled with Shelf Reader's desktop app

kokoro.web.js  — kokoro-js 1.2.1 (https://github.com/hexgrad/kokoro), Apache License 2.0.
                 Includes Transformers.js (Apache 2.0) and a phonemizer built from eSpeak NG (GPL-3.0).
                 The Kokoro-82M voice model is downloaded on first use from Hugging Face
                 (onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX), Apache License 2.0.
lame.all.js    — lamejs 1.2.1 (https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs), LGPL-3.0.
piper.web.js   — @mintplex-labs/piper-tts-web 1.0.5 (MIT), bundling onnxruntime-web 1.18.0 (MIT).
                 Piper voices are downloaded on demand from Hugging Face; each voice has its own
                 license listed in its MODEL_CARD.
pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.min.mjs — pdf.js (pdfjs-dist 6.5.438, https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js), Apache License 2.0.
../coi-serviceworker.min.js — coi-serviceworker 0.1.7 (https://github.com/gzuidhof/coi-serviceworker), MIT.
                 Only used when the audiobook maker is hosted somewhere that can't send COOP/COEP headers.
